major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start every ramp with it about 8 seconds before the damage lands, then spend the two Power Word: Radiance casts it makes instant.

major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on a damage window Evangelism is not covering, spell queue Void Shield just before the cast finishes, and channel Penance as you fall.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 421453 is the id seen in casts and in the self aura; 421543 and 421544 share the name and appear in no sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it every cooldown, on yourself inside a ramp or on the damage dealer your raid assigns it to.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it for the heaviest raid damage of the fight, when your Atonement healing alone will not cover the hit.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 64843 is the 3 minute cast id resolved by name lookup and verified against WCL game data; the sampled parses carry only its 64844 aura.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Pain stays up on your target
rule.action: Refresh it before it expires and spread it with offensive Penance casts.

rule.description: Power Word: Radiance right after Evangelism
rule.action: Follow it with both instant Power Word: Radiance casts before the damage lands.

rule.description: Ultimate Penitence outside your Evangelism window
rule.action: Save it for a damage event your Evangelism ramp is not already covering.
